requirement: Site changes opens on People and Tracy with a hidden-automatic line, titles a chat row by its request, and undoes a chat request with the turn engine through one button; rows the engine does not list keep today's actions

oracle.ref: PR #970 (feat); fix evidence: Measured 05/10/2026 on cowork.tracy.site: Site changes opened on Type: All with 53,339 events, 99.8% automatic; chat rows read 'Changed N files'; an opened chat row offered Undo file changes (files only) beside Ask Tracy to revert.
oracle.invariant: 0 failures. 'the list opens on People and Tracy, asked of the server, with the hidden line; Show is Type: All' passes. 'a Chat row is titled by the request, quoted, and says what changed under it' passes. 'an opened Chat row has ONE undo button; the dialog says what goes back; Undo calls the engine' passes. 'an older request: Go back to before this request, scope from-here, the later requests named' passes. 'blocked: the chat card’s sentence with who, what and when, and Ask Tracy to revert; no undo' passes. 'a Chat row the engine lists: no Undo file changes in its menu or its detail, one undo button' passes. 'rows the engine does not speak for keep Undo file changes in the menu' passes.
